derivation: rvt::compression::inflate_stream_at("Global/ElemTable", stored, 8) over the source .rvt yields 1057030 bytes (gzip CRC32 and ISIZE both verify). This fixture is bytes 0..0x1E of that stream with the u16 LE record_count at offset 2 rewritten from 26425 to 6, followed verbatim by records 0, 1, 2 and 26422, 26423, 26424 (40 bytes each, taken at 0x1E + 40*k). Total 0x1E + 6*40 = 270 bytes, so the fixture preserves the property under test: the record array is exactly record_count * stride bytes and ends flush with the end of the stream.
notes: Regression fixture for #206. On the pre-fix decoder the record origin was taken at the first 0xFF run (record +4) instead of the record's first byte, so a full stream walked one record short; on this excerpt that shows up as 5 records parsed instead of 6.
